quest.title: A Flower Blooms in a Prison
quest.description: After fulfilling Kamisato Ayaka's three wishes, you successfully win her trust. And now the next step is...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x1025, Primogem x30, Mora x49200, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x9

chapter.title: The Immovable God and the Eternal Euthymia

talks.objective: Return to the Kamisato Estate to see Kamisato Ayaka

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Traveler, Paimon... It is a pleasure to finally meet you both face-to-face, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I have heard all about how you helped our three friends. My sincerest thanks to you.

choices.text: Actually, we didn't really help at all...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* Yeah... short of getting them their Visions back, it seems like there's no way to really help them...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, Ayaka — how come this time you get to come out and meet us in person?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Hehe, because now that you have done the three things I asked of you, I consider you to be my friends. As you will observe, I dispense with the screen for Thoma, also.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Mm-hmm.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait a second, but isn't Thoma your, um... servant? Paimon's happy to help and all, but Paimon sure as heck did not sign up to be a servant!

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Oh...! Ahaha, Paimon you are most entertaining. Thoma is first and foremost my friend, and was so before he ever became my attendant.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, okay then... Ayaka, you seem pretty different out in the open compared to how you are behind the screen. Mmm... Alright, we can be friends.

choices.text: Alright then.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Hehe, thank you both kindly.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Back to the matter at hand. You have now witnessed the pain of those deprived of their Visions... What are your feelings on what you have seen?

choices.text: I hope they can one day be free from their torment.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: *sigh* ...Perhaps, in the eyes of a deity such as the Almighty Shogun, the lives of those who inhabit the world are inconsequential...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Thunder's roar, lightning's flash, the wind's assault, and the rain's descent... all these things take place with no regard for the feelings of the common people.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: But I believe that surely you understand what they must endure.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: It seems that perhaps now, you can appreciate my feelings on all of this. In which case... perhaps you would be willing to reconsider your stance?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I will help you fight the Vision Hunt Decree.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: You will? Really!?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But you must keep the promise you made me.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Naturally, hehe.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Alright, bravo, milady. You were right all along.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: #See... I told you {F#she}{M#he} wouldn't reject them. I'd placed my trust in the right person after all.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Now then, given that the remainder of our discussion pertains to matters of a more... confidential nature... perhaps we could move to the Komore Teahouse? We ought not to involve other members of the Yashiro Commission.

choices.text: It seems to be a fate worse than death.
Friend request accepted.
The damage done by losing a Vision can't be completely undone.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have no further questions.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, ooh, Paimon has a question though!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Oh? What would you like to know, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Have you got a plan yet? To fight the Vision Hunt Decree?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: To be honest... we do not.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—What!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Please, do not forget that challenging the Vision Hunt Decree is tantamount to challenging a deity. Coming to terms with that is already a difficult step to take.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... So, what're we gonna do?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Well, for the moment, all we can do is to try and reduce the harm that is being caused by this decree.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: For example, by providing Vision bearers with safe refuge, or manufacturing counterfeit Visions for them as a contingency measure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're telling Paimon that there are people out there who can make fake Visions!?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Don't underestimate the talents of the craftspeople in Hanamizaka. To the naked eye, their counterfeits are indistinguishable from the genuine article.

choices.text: Must have been where Venti went...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: The problem we are facing right now is that Master Masakatsu, who was providing us with counterfeit Visions, has recently been arrested by the Tenryou Commission.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh darn! So they found out about it? Ugh...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Yes... We knew it was not a long-term solution and that it was only a matter of time before it would be exposed... But we cannot simply abandon Master Masakatsu.

choices.text: He has saved many others.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Exactly, I feel the same way. But given mine and Thoma's identities as part of the Yashiro Commission, breaking him out of prison would risk dragging down the reputation of the entire Kamisato Clan should we be caught. That would only serve to cast suspicion on any future activity we might seek to attempt.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So you're offloading that job to me, huh?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Hehe, by no means do we intend to place the burden of such a task on your shoulders alone.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: When you are ready, go to Hanamizaka, and look for a fireworks shop run by the Naganohara family. There, you will find someone who can help you.

choices.text: It is only right that he should be saved, too.
I kind of want one, too...

dialogues.speaker: Okawara Goemon
dialogues.text: Just hand it over, you don't want any trouble with me.

dialogues.speaker: Okawara Goemon
dialogues.text: If you think your elemental powers are enough to resist the Vision Hunt Decree, then you'd better think again.

dialogues.speaker: Okawara Goemon
dialogues.text: Believe me, you're not the first of your kind we've encountered... And we've seen the same unpleasant outcome time after time. You'd best save yourself the trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Hanshirou
dialogues.text: Can't you make an exception? I just got this Vision — I won't even use it, I promise.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So this is the Vision Hunt Decree in action, huh? We can't just sit around and watch things unfold, can we?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's move!
Psst...! Hey — wait...!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? There's someone trying to get our attention.
Come on...! This way...!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, what's going on!? Can't you see we need to go help...
Shh! Quiet! Just sit tight and watch for a moment...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! This isn't right, y'know! Just because you don't have a Vision doesn't mean you can sit back and watch others in trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Hey wait... you do have a Vision!
Shh! If you don't keep your voice down, I won't have one much longer!

dialogues.speaker: Hanshirou
dialogues.text: Alright, alright... Here... take it.

dialogues.speaker: Okawara Goemon
dialogues.text: Hm, wise choice. Alright, let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What should we do now? He's already given up his Vision... Doesn't he know what could happen to him after losing it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, this is your fault. You're the one who stopped us from interfering!

dialogues.speaker: Hanshirou
dialogues.text: Phew! Many thanks, Miss Yoimiya. If you hadn't swapped me a fake just now, I'm sure I would have lost it.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: No worries! You put on quite the convincing performance!

choices.text: So the Vision they took was fake?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohh, so that's what's going on here! And to think Paimon was about to unleash Paimonial wrath on Miss Yoimiya... hehehe... sorry about that.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Haha, ahh think nothing of it! I could tell from your reaction we were on the same side — you just didn't know it, y'know?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Alright — allow me to introduce myself. I'm Yoimiya, the current owner of Naganohara Fireworks. It ain't much, but it's honest work, hehe. Great to meet ya!

response.speaker: Hanshirou
response.text: Practically everyone in Hanamizaka knows Yoimiya. She's the "Queen of the Summer Festival"! Without her and her fireworks, summer on Narukami Island just wouldn't be the same.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, that's quite the introduction! Paimon loves fireworks! It's nice to meet you.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Hee-hee, stop it Hanshirou, you'll embarrass me!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: As for thanking me, you'd be better off thanking Master Masakatsu. He's the one that gave me the fake Visions in the first place.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: His handiwork allowed me to keep my own Vision. Whew, I can't even imagine trying to run the business without it...

response.speaker: Hanshirou
response.text: Yes, Master Masakatsu is a good man. It's too bad good people seldom get the recognition they deserve.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Master Masakatsu!?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Huh? Do you guys know him too?

choices.text: Miss Kamisato mentioned his name.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: You don't say! Then it sounds like the Shirasagi Himegimi has a plan... Awesome! I've been thinking about breaking him out too recently.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: But if I just marched straight in there by myself, I'd probably get Miss Kamisato in a whole heap of trouble, hehe...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: So... what about if I join you instead!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure! Welcome to the team! Ayaka told us to go look for help at a fireworks shop. She must have meant you!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Hee-hee, seems like I've finally got a new job to do! ...Y'know, besides hiding Vision bearers in my shop, that is...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: So, Master Masakatsu is being held at the Police Station. I've already surveyed the area and found a way in.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, talk about a reliable source. Seems we've got the right person on our team!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Not bad, huh? Hehe. Let's go as soon as everyone's ready. Don't worry Master Masakatsu, we're on our way!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Time to break him out!

choices.text: We were just on our way to rescue him.
Seems we were fooled, too...

talks.objective: Go to the Police Station to help Master Masakatsu

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Now that we're inside, this place is a whole lot creepier than Paimon imagined... Eh-he...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: C'mon, this way! As long as we stay quiet, we've got a good chance!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I certainly wouldn't want to end up locked away in here... Let's find Master Masakatsu and get out of here.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: We should split up. I've got a "little present" to prepare for Master Masakatsu, hehe... I'll be right back.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You sure? Alright then... Just be careful not to get caught!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Yes, uh — you too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shh... quick, hide! Look over there...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That must be Master Masakatsu!

dialogues.speaker: Kinoshita
dialogues.text: ...Did you really think that little trick of yours could fool us?

dialogues.speaker: Maeda
dialogues.text: Hehe... locking you up was just the beginning.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Oh no... Those Tenryou Commission brutes are torturing him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If we don't come up with a way to break him out fast, then... Eh!? Yoimiya, when did you get back here...

choices.text: We can only grit our teeth for now...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Ugh... I can't bear to watch. If anything happens to Master Masakatsu, our whole plan will have been for nothing...
Hey, you there! What are you doing!?

response.speaker: Kinoshita
response.text: Ah! M—Ma'am!

response.speaker: Maeda
response.text: W—We were just teaching him a little lesson... That's all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Who's that?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: That's Kujou Sara, adopted daughter of the Kujou Clan of the Tenryou Commission. She's also a general in the Shogun's Army. What's she doing here...?

choices.text: I think Kazuha mentioned her before...

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Make way, let me have a look at him.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: I'm sure you're well aware that torture is strictly against military regulations.

response.speaker: Kinoshita
response.text: Y—Yes, ma'am.

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: If you are unashamed of such disgraceful action, then you are also unworthy of the Tenryou Commission itself! Do I make myself clear!?

response.speaker: Maeda
response.text: Y—Yes, ma'am. I—It won't happen again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whew, Paimon sure wouldn't want to get on her bad side...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Hey, this is our chance! Let's move while they aren't watching Master Masakatsu.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yoimiya! Are you sure now's the right time!?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Ah...

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Who is that...

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Quick, go and investigate.

response.speaker: Guards
response.text: Yes, ma'am!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Th—They're coming! Quick — hide!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Sorry sorry sorry! I didn't mean to...

choices.text: We're in trouble now.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Don't worry, I've got us covered. Time for my "little present..."

response.speaker: Fireworks
response.text: BOOM!!!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wha—! Fireworks!?

response.speaker: Kinoshita
response.text: Huh? Was that an explosion!?

response.speaker: Maeda
response.text: I—It sounded like... fireworks?

response.speaker: Kinoshita
response.text: Quick, let's hurry!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whew, the fireworks were enough to distract them! Maybe more than enough, hehe...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Hehe, fireworks aren't just for festivals y'know.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Nice work!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I knew we could count on you!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Hee-hee, I was particularly proud of this batch, I decided to—

response.speaker: Fireworks
response.text: POW!!! CRACKLE CRACKLE... FIZZZZ!

response.speaker: Guards
response.text: Wahhhhhh!!!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh-he... Uh, Yoimiya... this is turning into a bit of a fireworks display, hehe...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Well... fireworks are my craft after all. Every batch has to be spectacular! Hee-hee...

choices.text: I'm beginning to think this wasn't only intended as a distraction...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Look, the coast is clear. Now's our chance!

choices.text: Well, those guards deserved what they got...
They'll find us for sure if we don't do something.
She's also enforcing the Vision Hunt Decree.
We need to ensure we have a means of escape.

dialogues.speaker: Masakatsu
dialogues.text: Y—Yoimiya? Is that you?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Master Masakatsu! Sorry we took so long... Ugh... those awful guards!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: C'mon, we've got no time to lose! They could be back any minute...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You were over there watching us this whole time, weren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Yes. Leave, before I let my judgment get the better of me.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: He's in serious condition, be sure he gets immediate medical attention.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: But remember...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Once he's recovered, it won't be long until I bring him right back.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Uh, well... Ahem, you can bet we'll do all we can to keep that from happening.

choices.text: Thank you...

response.speaker: Kujou Sara
response.text: Hm... leave this place.

choices.text: We will protect Master Masakatsu.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew! We're finally outta that creepy place.

dialogues.speaker: Masakatsu
dialogues.text: Yes... Finally, I've made it out of there...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Master Masakatsu — how do you feel? Can you hold on?

dialogues.speaker: Masakatsu
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I think I can make it to the infirmary without keeling over.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Thank you, all of you! I'll take him to get treated. I'll treat you to a round of drinks once this is all over!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry about us, just take care of Master Masakatsu!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew, good thing we were able to rescue him.

choices.text: Luck was on our side this time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right, Kujou Sara... Do you think she was making up for how the guards were treating him?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It seems as though there are some okay people among the ranks of the Tenryou Commission... Oh! Though Paimon would never agree with their actions in the Vision Hunt Decree, of course.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How about we go tell Ayaka and the others the good news?

choices.text: All thanks to that person.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's stick to the classics...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's see what we've got here. Hmm, fresh fish fillets, shrimp, bamboo shoots...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nice! You can't go wrong with these. Paimon can't wait!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon never thought we'd be the only ones to actually put anything edible into the pot... Don't go wasting the rest now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* This was possibly the scariest-looking hot pot Paimon's ever seen... Fortunately, Thoma ended up eating all the weird stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: You can say that again... But hey, at least I got the most points... Ugh, wait a moment... that doesn't feel good...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I'm afraid it's your own fault for adding all those strange ingredients Thoma. The soup flavor wasn't quite the same afterwards...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: #Even with {NICKNAME}'s normal ingredients, I still couldn't guess any of them correctly.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #But weren't you the one who added those little cakes Ayaka? Hehe, I think {NICKNAME} ended up eating one.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Boiling cakes in hot pot... bleurgh... think of the texture...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I must apologize... To be perfectly honest, I thought the cakes would be a tasty addition.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Uh oh, I'm definitely not okay... Ugh, I need to lie down.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Whew... I feel like a new man.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, you know, Thoma... all you had to do was guess wrong on purpose and it would've been someone else's turn. Talk about being competitive...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Haha, guess I've been feeling unlucky recently and wanted the God of Hot Pot's blessing.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Perhaps I did get a little carried away... Still, I couldn't be beaten at my own game first time around!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I think my luck has already taken a turn for the better — I can sense it!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: So without further ado, I hereby declare that the winner of today's hot pot challenge is... me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh brother...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Ahh... good effort team, another important job taken care of. Next on the agenda: some well-earned rest and relaxation.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Yes, if the Tenryou Commission truly is as busy with preparations as Thoma claims, then some rest would be a welcome change of pace.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: And with the extra time, there are some other matters I wish to attend to...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Let's all take some much-needed time off. After a few days' rest, we'll reconvene at the Komore Teahouse and discuss our next operation.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Downtime is hard to come by these days, so be sure to make the most of it!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I'll tidy things up here and start thinking about our ingredients for our next round, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's gonna be a sequel!?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Sure, why not! We should play again now that everyone knows the rules. I'll see you all later!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bye, Thoma!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, seems we won't need to be visiting the Komore Teahouse for a while. Why don't we go explore some other places!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I see, so Kujou Sara stayed her hand. It would appear she still has some honor to her.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I wonder if we should try establishing contact with her... Perhaps we could coax out some information.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Unlikely.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Don't forget, Kujou Sara is also carrying out the Vision Hunt Decree. She obeys the orders of the Raiden Shogun without question.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: In her eyes, Master Masakatsu is of no threat to the decree. This is why she was so willing to allow his escape.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: If our true motives were ever divulged, she would act against us without a second thought.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: True... Though if you ask me, Master Masakatsu's release is an unexpected blessing.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: #We are now one step closer to victory... and we couldn't have done it without Yoimiya and {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Hehe, you're turning out to be even more reliable than we expected.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks for the compliment.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, don't mention it.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: #Indeed, things may have turned out very differently this time without the help of {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: But if we wish to mount any sizable resistance against the Vision Hunt Decree... there is still much to be done.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: It is time we make ready our next set of plans...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: There's no need to rush, milady.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Things seem to have taken a turn for the better, at least. Not only have we rescued Master Masakatsu, but our list of allies appears to be growing.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Ah yes, which reminds me... The Tenryou Commission seems to be making preparations for a "celebration"... They call it a "ceremony" of sorts.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: And the number of samurai out enforcing the Vision Hunt Decree seems to be waning. The days ahead may be more peaceful than usual.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: A "ceremony," you say? Why would such a task be left to the Tenryou Commission?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I don't know, but I'm sure it has nothing to do with us. Anyway, with the Tenryou Commission busy with preparations, we should have a little more breathing room than usual.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Hmm, you do present a good point.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Being in a constant state of alert will only tire us further, perhaps a period of rest is in order.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Thoma, what would you suggest?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I'd say a celebratory feast is in order. Might I suggest an evening of hot pot together!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Funny enough, I learned a new "hot pot game" recently. I'm sure you'll find it quite amusing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A hot pot game? What's that? Well, as long as it has to do with eating...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Simply put, every person prepares an ingredient to add to the hot pot. Once the meal begins, we add all the ingredients together.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Then we take it in turns to close our eyes, pick an ingredient out of the pot, taste it, and guess whose ingredient it was.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Anyone who guesses correctly can go again, and whoever finishes the meal with the most points is declared the winner. Tradition even has it that the winner receives blessings from the God of Hot Pot.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Don't you think it sounds like fun? Hehe, I've been wanting to give it a try... In fact, I've already got my ingredients prepared!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You really do wanna play, huh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, sounds like we've got our work cut out for us! Time to gather some ingredients. But... what should we choose?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, here we are again...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Please, continue without me. I'll keep watch.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, what's the deal with this place, anyway? What makes it your favorite meeting spot?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: This is land that was gifted to the Yashiro Commission by the shogun. The Kamisato Clan has the exclusive right to plan, build, and repair any property on this land — and even to allow or deny access.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Such privileges exist due to the Yashiro Commission's role in managing ceremonial affairs. Oftentimes, it is not appropriate to discuss details in front of bystanders.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohh Paimon gets it — gotta keep a bit of mystery, right?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Once the number of ceremonial affairs conducted in the city began to decline, our forebears built a teahouse here. Only members of the Yashiro Commission are permitted to come and go as they please.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Makes sense. Perfect place for a secret base!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: #In any case, we can talk freely here. I presume {NICKNAME}, you have a few questions that you wish to ask me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of god is the Raiden Shogun?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: The Almighty Shogun... I have seen her on but only a few occasions, most of them formal ceremonies...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: She inspires awe, commands respect, and exudes a sense of absolute authority. But as I recall, there was something else about her that struck me even more deeply...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: It was her almost complete lack of any emotion. In that sense, she appeared to me to be less of a ruler and more of... well, an executive official, I suppose. Focused exclusively on her single goal of implementing Eternity, acting accordingly without feeling.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is no one else fighting the Vision Hunt Decree?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: The issue is this... For the vast majority of people, the Vision Hunt Decree is something that has no implications whatsoever.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: After all, it is but a tiny minority of people who receive Visions. Moreover, it is not unknown for Visions to spark jealousy in others.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Because of this, the attitude of most people towards the Vision Hunt Decree is one of indifference.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How can they be like that...? Hmph, Paimon's getting mad...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Nevertheless, in addition to us, there is also the resistance on Watatsumi Island.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Resistance? You mean, like, an army fighting against the decree?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Yes, many who have lost or fear losing their Visions have rallied together under Sangonomiya on Watatsumi Island to form a resistance group.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: To say a little more about Sangonomiya... Historically, there has always been some conflict between them and the Shogunate of Narukami Island due to their different belief systems.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: But I do wonder whether there may be some other agenda behind their resistance movement, beyond merely fighting the Vision Hunt Decree...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you raised a formal objection to the Vision Hunt Decree?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Of course. We have tried on numerous occasions. Unfortunately, each time a proposal to repeal the decree arrives at Tenshukaku, it is promptly vetoed by both the Tenryou Commission and the Kanjou Commission, and subsequently scrapped...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: They invariably adopt a stance of unconditional support for the shogun's decisions. They have no interest in discussing anything.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: It almost makes one wonder whether they had a hand in the shogun's sudden decision to issue the Vision Hunt Decree...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's be team daredevil...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, Paimon proposes we gather raging demon-level Jueyun Chilis, super salty Ham, Mist Flower Corollas...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is already shaping up to be a hot pot to remember...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Ugh, my stomach! It feels like Yoimiya's fireworks are going off inside me...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who would've guessed that Thoma would be the winner...? He ate practically all those weird ingredients without a second thought! Uh, Thoma? You okay buddy?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Salt-crusted herring, unripe Lavender Melon, flash-boiled dango... Oh, and whatever that thing was that nearly froze my tongue off...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Hold up, my life is starting to flash before my eyes... Time I call it a night, everyone...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Hehe, you've only got yourself to blame Thoma... All those strange things you ate were ingredients you added yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #But weren't you the one who added those little cakes Ayaka? Hehe, I think {NICKNAME} ended up eating one.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Boiling cakes in hot pot... bleurgh... think of the texture...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I must apologize... To be perfectly honest, I thought the cakes would be a tasty addition.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Uh oh, I'm definitely not okay... Ugh, I need to lie down.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Whew... I feel like a new man.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, you know, Thoma... all you had to do was guess wrong on purpose and it would've been someone else's turn. Talk about being competitive...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Haha, guess I've been feeling unlucky recently and wanted the God of Hot Pot's blessing.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Perhaps I did get a little carried away... Still, I couldn't be beaten at my own game first time around!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I think my luck has already taken a turn for the better — I can sense it!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: So without further ado, I hereby declare that the winner of today's hot pot challenge is... me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh brother...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Ahh... good effort team, another important job taken care of. Next on the agenda: some well-earned rest and relaxation.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Yes, if the Tenryou Commission truly is as busy with preparations as Thoma claims, then some rest would be a welcome change of pace.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: And with the extra time, there are some other matters I wish to attend to...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Let's all take some much-needed time off. After a few days' rest, we'll reconvene at the Komore Teahouse and discuss our next operation.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Downtime is hard to come by these days, so be sure to make the most of it!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I'll tidy things up here and start thinking about our ingredients for our next round, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's gonna be a sequel!?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Sure, why not! We should play again now that everyone knows the rules. I'll see you all later!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bye, Thoma!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, seems we won't need to be visiting the Komore Teahouse for a while. Why don't we go explore some other places!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Hey, all finished? I've been keeping watch and I'm happy to report that everything is fine and dandy!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: You want to know who you'll be meeting in Hanamizaka? Let's just say... they'll be easy to find. You'll see what I mean when you get there, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Talk about a big door... Seems we need to collect something shaped like magatama in order to open it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This wall looks a bit odd... Maybe there's some special trick to it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These guys seem a lot tougher than usual... Paimon wonders if that armor over there has anything to do with the source of their strength?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Doesn't that magatama shape look pretty similar to the grooves on the door over there?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I might not have won this iteration of Masterful Chefs, but I definitely learned a lot from the competition itself!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I was just planning to invent a few new dishes for the Moonchase Festival and maybe learn a few things from Chef Xiangling, but I sure learned quite a few unexpected things, too!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: ...Actually, what are you doing, just sauntering on into the kitchen again?

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Ah, so Yanxiao came in second this year. A shame, but also not a bad thing.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Cooking is much like martial arts. One can only improve when rivals to compete with.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: I'll bet that he's cooking up some new recipes as we speak. Well, I sure hope I'll get to try some of it.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Hello! I am Huai'an, innkeeper of the Wangshu Inn.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Our inn is a fine vantage spot for moon-viewing. The view from the top floor is excellent, with obstructed views of the moon and of the surrounding scenery alike.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Hello! Oh! Well, you certainly are a returning customer. Welcome back.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: You've come at a good time: the Moonchase Festival is the best time for viewing the moon and enjoying gourmet food, and Wangshu Inn has plenty of both.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Oh, child, it's you! The Moonchase Festival is a most lively time here in Liyue, so feel free to walk around and see the sights.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Stove God...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Well, now you know that the Moonchase Festival was instituted by Rex Lapis as a way of remember that friend of ours.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: You call him Guoba nowadays, do you not? Hehe, I suppose it was destiny that led Xiangling to rename the God of the Stove for a dish they both enjoyed.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Take him around Liyue Harbor — you and Xiangling both — a little more, would you?

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: I'm sure he would be gladdened to see Liyue Harbor as populous as it presently is.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Hello there, youngster. Here to enjoy the Moonchase Festival?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Back in the day, we would eat Wangxiao Cakes, drink Laurel Wine, and gather together with family and friends to share our hopes for the future.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Nowadays, the number dishes to be had has grown and grown, and we aren't quite as particular as we once were — we simply eat whatever we wish.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Take the opportunity to try some more of Liyue's delicacies, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Here for the Wanmin Restaurant experience? Hi, I'm Chef Mao. Everyone in Chihu Rock will have heard of me.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: My name might not be the most famous around, but my daughter Xiangling is the champion of this year's Masterful Chefs. Now hers is a name I'm sure everyone's heard of!

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Haha! That's my dear girl alright, our very own culinary genius. Her future is very bright indeed!

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: The Moonchase Festival is here, and with it, the Masterful Chefs tournament. All the Liyue locals are getting fired up about good food again, it seems.

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: Should I take this chance to try a few more Liyue dishes? Oh, but the food here is just...

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's the Moonchase Festival, and the food here's only getting better... But my brother is still as weak as ever...

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: I've heard that this iteration of Masterful Chefs has seen quite a few new dishes come to light. You know what? I'm just going to drag him off to try them all one by one!

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: I'm pumped to try something different form the usual fare. After all, they're just... you know, there.

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: Manager Kuan! I want the moon!

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: Hey, aren't each of your requests becoming less reasonable than the last? Also, for the last time, just call me "Daddy."

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: Nope. Also, my requests are not that unreasonable.

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: Isn't the Moonchase Festival all about chasing the moon? If you can get it for me, Manager Kuan, then no one will have to chase it.

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: That would make you everyone's hero, Manager Kuan!

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: I'm not some hero, I'm just Kuan... No, wait, I'm your Daddy!

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: Well, if you're my Daddy, and then you can fulfill my wishes, right? I'll study hard, and you'll get me the moon. That's fair, right?

dialogues.speaker: Manager Kuan
dialogues.text: I don't think this is a question of fairness. It's more that... I can't get the moon in the first place.

dialogues.speaker: Yiran
dialogues.text: *sigh* Then until you get the moon, you're not a hero, you're Manager Kuan.

dialogues.speaker: Yicheng
dialogues.text: Hello there! *LOUD RUMBLING* Happy *RUMBLE* Moonchase Festival...

dialogues.speaker: Yicheng
dialogues.text: Eat more at the *RUMBLE* Masterful Chefs...

dialogues.speaker: Huihui
dialogues.text: C'mon, Li Cuisine was clearly the superior tradition this time at Masterful Chefs!

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: Oh sure, that sounds like something only Li lovers would say!

dialogues.speaker: Huihui
dialogues.text: Well, why don't you just accept that there's nothing redeemable about Yue Cuisine? Did you see that boiled fish dish in the qualifiers? Made that judge's face turn green just from tasting it! You could smell the rank flavor of soil from a mile away...

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: W—Well, it's not like Li Cuisine fared any better. I heard that one of the judges failed to show up at the finals because they got a tummy ache from tasting some Li Cuisine during the semi-finals!

dialogues.speaker: Huihui
dialogues.text: Nonsense! A tummy ache's got nothing to do with the dish's taste. Li Cuisine is just superior!

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: Hmph, you're clearly only saying that because you've never properly tried Yue food before. I bet you've never even BEEN to the Xinyue Kiosk!

dialogues.speaker: Huihui
dialogues.text: And I bet YOU have never had proper Li cuisine at Liuli Pavilion!

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Welcoming the bright moonlight to illuminate the adeptal path — what a romantic scene!

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: I should really start collecting some antiques related to the festival...

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: It's festival time here in Liyue again. Thanks for accepting my invitation to view the moon together...

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: I'd originally planned to invite you to some famous restaurant, but I didn't think that they'd been fully booked ages ago...

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: It's alright. I've heard that the theme of this festival is gourmet food. It's not all that surprising that there were no tables left.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Eh? I—Is that so... So that's why I couldn't book any seats...

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Looks like my lack of understanding about Liyue was to blame. I'm sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Eh? Oh, no, you don't have to apologize...

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Just being able to relax and watch the bright moon together is good enough for me.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Don't you think the moon at this time is brighter and rounder than usual?

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Oh, is it? ...No, I mean... You're right. It truly is very beautiful.

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: The Moonchase Festival is here, and Daddy still isn't back...

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: The latest Masterful Chefs was super exciting. I've started learning how to cook, too!

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Once Daddy gets back, I'll make him something nice for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: *sigh* And here I was thinking that I'd be able to take a break during the festival...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Instead, I've been working overtime due to the large increase in the demand for cooking ingredients...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Well, what can I say? I guess everyone here just loves to eat.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Hello, welcome to the Moonchase Festival here in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: The theme of this year's Moonchase Festival is gourmet food, and this iteration of Masterful Chefs is being organized by the Liyue Qixing themselves. With all the great chefs taking part, this is one show you don't want to miss!

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: I hope that everyone will have a good time during the festival. Of course, if you do have civil affairs at hand, please direct your concerns to the Ministry.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Haha! It was the right call to come here during the festival. You just can't beat the festive cheer here in the city!

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: I've heard that the Moonchase Festival used to be celebrated for very different reasons in the past. Something about the adepti's rituals, I believe.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: But I don't think that what it's about now — gathering together and admiring the moon — is half bad, either!

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: I'm sure that the adepti, too, would be gladdened to see everyone enjoying themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: Have you heard the news? Captain Beidou of the Crux brought something amazing back from overseas again!

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: They say that it's the statue of an ancient adeptus... Or a god... Well, whatever it is, it's a really awesome statue!

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: Well, it's the Crux Fleet, you know? Anything they're packing is bound to be good. Well then. Would you like something today, friend?

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: The Moonchase Festival really is a busy time. Looking at all the locals running about preparing food, I can't help but be tempted to try my hand at it myself.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Do you think some Snezhnayan fare and some grilled pies and such would sell well?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Moonchase Festival...

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: The meaning of the Festival in ages past was quite different. It was about the ancients of Liyue seeking the adeptal path.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: Nowadays, it's more about admiring the moon, eating, and enjoying our time together with one another.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: The meaning of festivals will shift with time, and some traditions will be forgotten. However, everyone's hopes for the future will remain the same, no matter what the day or age.
